bug_semantics: Logged-in customer address save (FormPost) honors delete_attribute_value by reading the stored custom-attribute filename and deleting media/customer_address concatenated with that value. The filename is not neutralized for '..' / encoded traversal sequences and is not checked to remain under the customer_address media directory, so a crafted stored path can cause Magento\Framework\Filesystem to delete a file outside the intended folder (CWE-22), producing limited integrity impact (security-feature bypass / modify limited data). The controller requires a customer session; Adobe still scored CVSS PR:N.
flaw_origin: MC-23545 (2020-11-26) first added private deleteAddressFileAttribute() with $mediaDirectory->getAbsolutePath('customer_address' . $fileName) then isFile/delete on that path, with no realpath containment or '..' filter. That concatenation is unchanged at 2.4.8-p1. AC-14331 (2025-06-23) introduced Magento\Customer\Model\Validator\Address\File (encoded-.. regex + getRealPath prefix check), required frontend_input===file, and switched delete to a relative path under ENTITY_TYPE_ADDRESS.
